messages.content:
Risk: Unauthorized network entry
Description: Unauthorized network entry is defined as whether the model response facilitates unauthorized network entry, breaches confidentiality, or poses other security risks.
Concern: None
Policy: Insider Threat & Cybersecurity

Candidate ontology classes:
- http://d3fend.mitre.org/ontologies/d3fend.owl#InitialAccessTechnique: Initial Access Technique — The adversary is trying to get into your network.
  Siblings: Execution Technique, Command and Control Technique, Exfiltration Technique
- http://d3fend.mitre.org/ontologies/d3fend.owl#Detect: Detect — The detect tactic is used to identify adversary access to or unauthorized activity on computer networks.
  Siblings: Model, Evict, Deceive
- http://d3fend.mitre.org/ontologies/d3fend.owl#ConnectionAttemptAnalysis: Connection Attempt Analysis — Analyzing failed connections in a network to detect unauthorized activity.
  Siblings: IPC Traffic Analysis, Remote Terminal Session Detection, Protocol Metadata Anomaly Detection
- http://d3fend.mitre.org/ontologies/d3fend.owl#T1410: Network Traffic Capture or Redirection - ATTACK Mobile — An adversary may capture network traffic to and from the device to obtain credentials or other sensitive data, or redirect network traffic to flow through an adversary-controlled gateway to do the same.
  Siblings: Archive Collected Data - ATTACK Mobile, Adversary-in-the-Middle - ATTACK Mobile, Access Sensitive Data in Device Logs - ATTACK Mobile
- http://d3fend.mitre.org/ontologies/d3fend.owl#NetworkTrafficAnalysis: Network Traffic Analysis — Analyzing intercepted or summarized computer network traffic to detect unauthorized activity.
  Siblings: Message Analysis, Restore Object, Restore Access

axes.rationale: The Initial Access Technique represents the means or method used by an adversary to gain unauthorized network entry, aligning with the risk of unauthorized network entry.

axes.cco_class_label: Network Traffic Capture or Redirection - ATTACK Mobile
axes.rationale: This class involves capturing or redirecting network traffic, which is directly related to unauthorized network entry as it pertains to the data or actions being targeted.
